sources.title: LLaVA-Med: Large Language and Vision Assistant for Biomedicine
sources.snippet: Large Language and Vision Assistant for bioMedicine (i.e., "LLaVA-Med") is a large language and vision model trained using a curriculum learning method for adapting LLaVA to the biomedical domain. It is an open-source release intended for research use only to facilitate reproducibility of the corresponding paper which claims improved performance for open-ended biomedical questions ...

sources.title: LLaVA-Med: Training a Large Language-and-Vision Assistant for ...
sources.snippet: This enables us to train a Large Language and Vision Assistant for BioMedicine (LLaVA-Med) in less than 15 hours (with eight A100s). LLaVA-Med exhibits excellent multimodal conversational capability and can follow open-ended instruction to assist with inquiries about a biomedical image.

sources.title: LLaVA-Med: Biomedical Vision-Language Models
sources.snippet: LLaVA-Med is a family of vision-language models designed for biomedical imaging, enabling automated medical reasoning and visual Q&A. It employs a two-stage training strategy with concept/alignment pretraining on PMC and GPT-4-generated multimodal dialogs for robust instruction tuning.
